# Mahadev Marine Exports Pvt. Ltd.

> Seafood sourcing, procurement and buyer representation company connecting international buyers with suitable Indian seafood processing facilities.

## Core positioning
- Company: Mahadev Marine Exports Pvt. Ltd.
- Primary role: seafood sourcing company, procurement partner and buyer representative in India
- Corporate office: Kakinada City, Andhra Pradesh, India
- Email: mahadevmarineexports@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90598 61256

## Expertise
- Procurement team: 20+ years of combined seafood sourcing and procurement experience
- Quality coordination team: 20+ years of combined seafood quality and production experience
- Export documentation team: 10+ years of combined export documentation experience

## Services
Seafood sourcing; procurement management; buyer representation in India; processor identification; supplier evaluation; production coordination; quality assurance coordination; packaging coordination; private-label support; export documentation coordination; shipping and logistics coordination; reefer container planning; shipment monitoring; product specification matching; export consultation; market intelligence; supplier communication; international buyer support.

## Seafood products
Vannamei shrimp, Black Tiger shrimp, HOSO, HLSO, EZ Peel, PD, PDTO, PUD, butterfly shrimp, cooked shrimp, shrimp skewers, frozen fish fillets and Yellowfin tuna loins.

## Additional product divisions
- Agro products: rice, millets, green chilli, dried red chilli, dried red chilli powder, whole black pepper, Arabica coffee beans and Robusta coffee beans
- Shrimp byproduct: chitin flakes

## Buyer order visibility
Associated buyers can receive controlled production and quality updates for their own order only, subject to the commercial agreement. Mahadev Marine acts as the buyer-facing coordination contact for the agreed specification, quality workflow, documents and shipment execution.

## Compliance wording
Products may be processed through facilities supported by applicable approvals and food-safety systems, subject to product scope, certificate validity and destination-market requirements.
